value.rationale: The complete 33-code length-32 repeated-root chain is a canonical full finite classification in symbol-read coding theory. Triplet-weight distributions give exact read-weight multiplicities absent from known distance minima, with marked distinct minimum-weight populations (144 vs 112) despite equal distance six. This is motivated by symbol-read error behavior, not an arbitrarily chosen isolated code. The ambient row is included as a baseline rather than new research; substantive value lies in the 31 nontrivial proper-code spectra.
